description: Public, intentionally curated facts about Kingez and the developer portfolio. No private Jarvis memory, credentials, telemetry, personal contacts, or user prompts.
fallback: I only answer questions about Kingez, his public projects, development work and commissions. Try asking about Jarvis, ModAI, Discord bots, Minecraft plugins or how to contact him.

topics.title: About Kingez
topics.answer: Kingez (GitHub: kayden-pixel) builds Minecraft server tools, Discord bots, Node.js backend systems, local AI assistants and connected-device projects. This portfolio showcases both released software and private prototypes.

topics.title: Birthday
topics.answer: Kingez lists his birthday as 16 June 2001 on his public developer portfolio.

topics.title: Projects & systems
topics.answer: The portfolio showcases 12 projects across Minecraft, Discord, desktop AI, Android and backend software. Highlights include KingPro/Jarvis, ModAI, OmniPanel, Kydora Home, SENSE, the SA Exam Research Engine, HoloDesk and Orbital Strike. Some are public releases and others are clearly labelled private or experimental.

topics.title: Languages & tools
topics.answer: His everyday stack centres on Node.js and JavaScript for bots, APIs and real-time systems; Java for Paper/Spigot plugins; Python for AI and automation; and React/HTML/CSS for interfaces. Some projects also use Kotlin/Jetpack Compose for Android.

topics.title: Custom Discord bots
aliases: can you build a discord bot
how much for a discord bot
topics.answer: Kingez takes enquiries for custom Discord bot work such as moderation, security, role panels, tickets, setup flows and API integrations. A one-year Discord Nitro gift may be considered as payment for an agreed, clearly scoped project; discuss the requirements and terms with him before sending anything.

topics.title: One-year Nitro commission option
topics.answer: For suitable custom Discord bot commissions, Kingez is open to discussing a one-year Discord Nitro gift as compensation. The exact features, delivery and support need agreement first. There is no automatic checkout or request to send gifts upfront.

topics.title: ModAI security bot
topics.answer: ModAI is Kingez's Discord moderation/security system. It brings anti-raid and anti-nuke safeguards, incident handling, evidence, policy controls and moderation review into a more unified workflow. The core project is private.

topics.title: KingPro / Jarvis
topics.answer: KingPro (Jarvis) is Kingez's private Windows-first AI assistant project. It explores voice/text interaction, model routing, plugin tools and permission-controlled local actions. The public portfolio chat cannot control Jarvis or read private Jarvis memory.

topics.title: Jarvis integration boundaries
aliases: does this chatbot use an llm
topics.answer: The website and Jarvis can use the same explicitly public portfolio knowledge. Visitors only receive approved public answers. The website does not connect to Kingez's PC, run Jarvis tools, access local memory, or expose private models.

topics.title: OmniPanel
topics.answer: OmniPanel is Kingez's publicly released Minecraft server administration plugin for Paper/Purpur, with staff workflows, permissions, management menus, and integrations. Check the Modrinth page for actual releases and version support.

topics.title: Kingez PvP Pack
topics.answer: Kingez341YT PvP Pack is a public Minecraft resource pack focused on cleaner PvP visibility, such as shorter swords and reduced visual clutter. Versions and downloads are on Modrinth.

topics.title: Kydora Home
topics.answer: Kydora Home connects trusted Windows PCs and Android phones for approved pairing and encrypted file transfers. Its installers are publicly downloadable, while its application source is private. Tailscale is used for remote connectivity.

topics.title: SENSE Android beta
topics.answer: SENSE is an early Android beta exploring local-first sensing, BLE-based proximity ideas, privacy-conscious UI and optional shared audio. The public source and beta status are on GitHub; hardware calibration remains unfinished.

topics.title: SA Exam Research Engine
topics.answer: The SA Exam Research Engine is a private, local-first project that indexes South African exam PDFs with source metadata, SQLite search, rule-based analysis and a local dashboard. It is not yet a trained exam-prediction language model.

topics.title: Skystrike Survival
topics.answer: Skystrike Survival was Kingez's Minecraft SMP/server project. The public server is retired, but the work demonstrates Paper, permissions, WorldGuard and deployment experience.

topics.title: HoloDesk UI project
topics.answer: HoloDesk is an experimental Windows interface project exploring webcam hand tracking, gestures and futuristic spatial-style UI controls. It is a prototype, not a finished public product.

topics.title: DevLaunch Bot
topics.answer: DevLaunch Bot is Kingez's private Discord community assistant project combining a guided setup panel, conversational help and GitHub-based developer discovery.

topics.title: Orbital Strike
topics.answer: Orbital Strike is a private Minecraft gameplay plugin exploring unlockable combat abilities, progression, cooldowns and player-facing control menus.

topics.title: How to contact Kingez
topics.answer: For commissions, project discussions or collaboration, join Kingez's Discord server. Describe the project, required features, version/stack and timeframe so he can assess the scope.

topics.title: Commission details
topics.answer: Commission scope and terms are discussed individually. A one-year Discord Nitro gift can be proposed for certain custom Discord bot projects, but complex integrations, hosting and ongoing support are not automatically included. Nothing is payable through this website.

topics.title: Public vs private projects
topics.answer: Released public work includes OmniPanel, the PvP Pack, SENSE's public source and Kydora Home installers. Projects such as KingPro, ModAI and SA Exam Research Engine are private or in development. Their source is not exposed by this portfolio.

topics.title: Backend & integration services
topics.answer: Kingez builds Node.js bot backends, APIs, real-time Socket.IO-style systems, automation and service integrations. Hosting and protected backends are separate from this GitHub Pages site.
